mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2% for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% indicates a weak labor market that triggers expectations of further monetary accommodation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a weakening in consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS occurs in 10 consecutive months, but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in 70% of those months.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%), the market anticipates imminent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls above 100k per month indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k per month for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of those months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 95.0, S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 850,000 units signals a weakening in the housing sector, a key driver of consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 850, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and nonfarm payrolls signals a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and PAYEMS occurs in 10 consecutive months, but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in 70% of those months.
